intro.text:
Suzanne Brigit Bird (born October 16, 1980) is an American former professional basketball player who played for twenty years in the United States and Russia. She was drafted with the first overall pick by the Seattle Storm in the 2002 WNBA draft and played for the Storm for her entire Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) career. During her ten seasons in the Russian Premier League, she played for Dynamo Moscow, Spartak Moscow Region and UMMC Ekaterinburg, winning five Premier League championships and five EuroLeague Women championships. Bird is considered one of the greatest players in WNBA history.
Bird had a record of 114–4 during her college career at the University of Connecticut (UConn). During her senior year, her team was undefeated and she won the Wade Trophy and the Naismith Award as College Player of the Year. She finished her UConn career ranked first in three-point field goal percentage and free throw percentage, and won the Nancy Lieberman Award three times as the top point guard in the nation.
